scope: Supplemental development-only picture export and rescoring of the already retained base output; original baseline remains immutable
normalization: Collapse whitespace in semantic Markdown, preserving case, Unicode, punctuation and markup. The stable relative picture link participates in Markdown comparison.
acceptance: EOS, no parser/export diagnostics, exact normalized Markdown and ordered top-level kind/level signature, exactly one source-backed picture, and picture-box IoU >= 0.8. Classification is reported but not scored because the manual reference does not infer one.
failure_policy: Missing/malformed/truncated output scores as empty Markdown and failed structure/picture checks. Retain raw, IDs, diagnostics and any export failure. Never repair output or replace/crop the full model input.
development_exposure: Reference was authored after base output was observed but from the original scan, not copied from output. Supplemental scores are development-only and never replace the frozen original baseline.
selection: May be used only as part of the fixed three-page development validation after this protocol commit. Final data remains sealed. No adapter promotion if any candidate lacks all three outputs or violates exact artifact identity.
